+def _temporal_routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+    source, target = data["source"], data["target"]
+    initial_mask = bit.get(source, 0)
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])
+    dist = {initial: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])]
+    while queue:
+        arrival, node, mask, coupons = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, coupons)
+        if dist.get(state) != arrival:
+            continue
+        if node == target and mask == full:
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(arrival, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            choices = [(edge["duration"], coupons)]
+            if coupons:
+                duration = max(1, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                choices.append((duration, coupons - 1))
+            for duration, left in choices:
+                new_time = depart + duration
+                if new_time > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                new_mask = mask | bit.get(edge["v"], 0)
+                nxt = (edge["v"], new_mask, left)
+                if new_time < dist.get(nxt, float("inf")):
